title: Longest Palindromic Substring
prompt:
Return the longest substring of `s` that is a palindrome. *(If several tie, the tests here expect the first one encountered scanning left to right.)*

**Example**: `"babad"` → `"bab"`.

Expand around each center: every palindrome has a center (a character, or the gap between two characters), so try all 2n-1 centers and grow outward.
hints: Try each index as an odd-length center, and each gap as an even-length center.
A helper expands `(l, r)` while the characters match and returns the palindrome length.
Track the best center/length and slice the substring at the end.

solution.explanation: Every palindrome is symmetric about a center, and there are only 2n-1 possible centers. Expanding each outward is O(n) per center, O(n²) total — simpler than the O(n²) DP table and with O(1) space. The first-wins tie-break comes from only updating on a strictly longer find.
